manualFollowUps: Pages: before merging, create the Pages project once (wrangler pages project create schood-company --production-branch main) so the merge deploy of apps/company succeeds; after merging, run the 'Configure Schood Company English Domain' workflow to bind company.schood.online. Until the function is deployed the app shows a connection error; the landing page renders without it.

Database: supabase db push --linked --include-all from an isolated copy of the installed migrations plus only the four company migrations (20261031100000, 20261031120000, 20261031130000, 20261031140000), keeping the 9 pending #220 payment migrations (20261010162000-20261010174000) excluded. Dry run first. Purely additive: new company_* tables (RLS on, service role only), functions company_sync_english_access / company_sync_org_access / company_reserve_test / company_consume_ai / company_purge_training_drafts / company_activity_summary, and account_personal_erasure_tables() gains the company tables.

Secrets (--project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel): supabase secrets set COMPANY_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://company.schood.online; supabase secrets set COMPANY_SELF_SERVE=true; supabase secrets set COMPANY_APP_URL=https://company.schood.online. Optional, with defaults: COMPANY_PILOT_TESTS (10), COMPANY_AI_DAILY_LIMIT (300 AI calls per workspace per day).

Edge: supabase functions deploy company --project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel (verify_jwt=false in config.toml; the function checks sessions itself). It uses the existing English AI gateway, so OPENROUTER/English AI settings already in place apply and calls are logged in english_ai_calls.

Commercial: pilots are self-serve (10 tests, no learning seats). Learning seats, test limits and contract dates are set by Schood staff at /staff; a seat grants the Schood English All Skills entitlement with source 'company'.
verification: supabase migration list --linked shows the four 20261031 company migrations applied and the 9 #220 payment migrations still pending.
Anon REST select on company_orgs and company_members returns 401/permission denied (no anon or authenticated grants).

GET https://<project>.supabase.co/functions/v1/company/me without a session returns 401 unauthorized; GET .../company/public/v/UNKNOWN returns 404; POST .../company/public/leads with an empty body returns 400.
https://company.schood.online renders the landing page in en/ru/uz; /t/unknowntoken shows the link-not-active message.
With a staff account: /staff lists workspaces; a test pilot can be created at /start and shows 10 tests in Settings.

rollback.pages: Cloudflare Pages rollback of schood-company to the previous deployment, or remove the company.schood.online custom domain.
rollback.migration: Leave the additive tables in place; to stop access set every company_orgs.status to 'suspended' and run select public.company_sync_org_access(id) from company_orgs, which revokes company-granted English entitlements and restores learners' own rows.
rollback.edge: supabase functions delete company (or deploy a stub returning 503); no other function depends on it.
